lines.text: الجلوس والوقوف من كرسي (الجانبين). قف من الكرسي دون استخدام يديك، ثم اجلس ببطء. 3 × 10، كل يوم.
lines.source_en: Sit-to-stand from a chair (both sides). Stand up from a chair without using your hands, then sit down slowly. 3 × 10, every day.
lines.back_translation: Sitting and standing from a chair (both sides). Stand up from the chair without using your hands, then sit slowly. 3 × 10, every day.

lines.text: تقويم الركبة جالسًا مع شريط (اليمين). اجلس على كرسي والشريط حول الكاحل، وقم بتقويم الركبة ببطء. 3 × 12، كل يومين. زفر الهواء عند تقويم الركبة.
lines.source_en: Seated knee straightening with a band (right). Sit on a chair with the band around the ankle and straighten the knee slowly. 3 × 12, every other day. Breathe out as you straighten the knee.
lines.back_translation: Straightening the knee while sitting with a band (right). Sit on a chair with the band around the ankle, and straighten the knee slowly. 3 × 12, every two days. Exhale when straightening the knee.

lines.text: الخطوة للأعلى (اليمين). اخطُ للأعلى على الدرجة السفلى مع تقديم ساقك اليمنى أولاً، ثم انزل. 2 × 10، كل يوم. امسك درابزين الدرج.
lines.source_en: Step-up (right). Step up onto the bottom stair leading with your right leg, then step down. 2 × 10, every day. Hold the stair rail.
lines.back_translation: Step-up (right). Step up onto the lower step leading with your right leg, then step down. 2 × 10, every day. Hold the staircase railing.

lines.text: المشي. امشِ بسرعة مريحة. 20 دقيقة، 5 أيام في الأسبوع. بعض ألم الركبة أثناء المشي مقبول إذا زال بحلول الصباح التالي.
lines.source_en: Walking. Walk at a comfortable pace. 20 minutes, 5 days a week. Some knee pain while walking is acceptable if it has settled by the next morning.
lines.back_translation: Walking. Walk at a comfortable speed. 20 minutes, 5 days a week. Some knee pain while walking is acceptable if it disappears by the next morning.

lines.text: تمدد الساق الخلفي ضد الحائط (اليمين). انحنِ ضد الحائط مع وضع ساقك اليمنى خلفك، كعبك على الأرض، وامسك. 3 × 30 ثانية، كل يوم.
lines.source_en: Calf stretch against a wall (right). Lean against a wall with your right leg behind you, heel down, and hold. 3 × 30 seconds, every day.
lines.back_translation: Stretching the back of the leg against the wall (right). Lean against the wall with your right leg behind you, your heel on the ground, and hold.

lines.text: ارتقِ بخطوة متقدمة بالساق اليمنى ثم انزل (اليمين). 2 × 10، كل يوم. أمسك دائمًا بمسند الدرج.
lines.source_en: Step up leading with right leg then step down (right). 2 × 10, every day. Always hold the stair rail.
lines.back_translation: Rise with a step forward with the right leg then descend (right). 2 × 10, every day. Always hold the handrail.
